decision.expected_measurable_effect: In a re-run of the same task with terminal_tip_speed_weight and holding_tip_speed_weight raised from 0.0 to 0.01 (all other fields fixed), expect the sampled final-holding-window (0.30-0.35 s) speed range to fall below the baseline 0.6352-1.5810 m/s toward the 0.02 m/s settling limit and the peak sampled error to fall below the baseline 0.0581381 m, with reach_passed remaining true (terminal_error_m still <= 0.01 m) and mean_update_s / applied-update count roughly unchanged. A terminal_speed_m_s still near 0.6352 m/s, holding-window speeds still well above 0.02 m/s, or another overrun-limited run with only ~6 applied updates would indicate the change did not measurably help or that the overrun dominates the outcome.
decision.rationale: Bounded two-weight experiment, adopted because the diagnosed dominant supported observation is a speed failure and the two exposed tip-speed penalties are both at legacy zero. Baseline cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef reaches (reach_passed true, terminal_error_m 0.0076426 m below the 0.01 m tolerance) but fails to hold (holding_position_passed, holding_speed_passed, joint_reach_holding_passed all false); across all 6 recorded final-window samples (0.30-0.35 s) sampled speed spans 0.6352-1.5810 m/s against the 0.02 m/s limit and sampled error spans 0.0076426-0.0581381 m against the 0.01 m limit, with terminal_speed_m_s 0.6352 m/s and late_max_speed_m_s 1.5810 m/s. The recipe currently records terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 and holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0, so the legacy plan carries no explicit tip-speed objective. Hypothesis: enabling a modest positive weight on squared normalized tip speed at the plan terminal node (terminal_tip_speed_weight) and on nodes at/after the configured settling-window start (holding_tip_speed_weight) makes the optimizer favour plans that decelerate the tip before and within the holding window, lowering sampled holding speed while keeping reach. Why these weights: they are the only exposed knobs and they encode exactly the failed quantity (tip speed); the tip both enters the window already moving (terminal speed 0.6352 m/s) and moves within it (up to 1.5810 m/s), so a single weight would leave one regime uncosted. Scale (tip_speed_scale_m_s 0.02) and scheduling are left unchanged: the terminal term remains a single scaled squared-speed term and the holding term remains an integration-step-weighted node sum. Expected effects: (reach) should stay passing given the 0.0076426 m margin, though a terminal speed/position trade-off could erode it; (holding position) indirect improvement if the tip settles, reducing the 0.0581381 m peak; (holding speed) primary target, expected below the 0.635-1.581 m/s range toward the 0.02 m/s limit; (computation) the holding term is a cheap node-weighted sum so cost is expected roughly unchanged, but the run already averaged 17.263319 s per update against a 0.01 s period with 35/35 deadline misses and only 6 noninitialization updates applied, so overrun may dominate the closed-loop outcome and the trial may be inconclusive rather than decisive. Values kept modestly positive and equal (0.01 each) because raw weight magnitude does not establish cost-term importance without retained cost contributions, and normalized squared tip speeds at these speeds are already O(1e3). Possible adverse effects: a weight that dominates the objective could command aggressive braking or overshoot, degrade reach above the 0.01 m tolerance, or change solver usability/update count. Observations that would weaken the hypothesis: a re-run still showing holding-window speeds far above 0.02 m/s with terminal speed still near 0.635 m/s; again only ~6 applied updates, indicating overrun masks the weight; terminal_error exceeding 0.01 m; or no measurable difference between the two weights because few holding nodes are scheduled. No dominant cause and no winning value is presumed; this is a bounded, reversible trial and a single execution cannot establish causality.

final_response.reasoning:
Adopting the report recommendation "retain_baseline_weights_no_adoption": the one authorized bounded experiment is a measured failure under the frozen campaign comparison, so the executed weight change must not be carried forward.

Basis (complete accepted pair): candidate improvement-b2034534c646, execution dc92d065f2f74500802e4d524d6645a7, evaluation validity valid and complete, whose only effective changes were holding_tip_speed_weight and terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.01. The candidate loses the reach pass the baseline held: candidate terminal_reach_passed=false [fd25ecb316a71] vs baseline true [f9b62cf5c760b], candidate official_reach_task_success=false [fab68cf8617ee], candidate terminal_error_m 0.025442 m [fce76d5b268ad] vs baseline 0.0076426 m [fd3a8bf5df23b], i.e. outside the 0.01 m reach tolerance. Holding still fails and is worse: baseline holding_position_passed=false [fe14a467a41f7] and joint_reach_holding_passed=false [fcca534323073]; candidate sampled settling max error 0.065217 m [fa19946e38ac5] vs baseline final-window max 0.058138 m [f96ad44b1fe5f], and the program-derived candidate-minus-baseline holding_max_speed_m_s is +0.643106 m/s [f9d72dc33c94e], with the baseline window already spanning 0.635-1.581 m/s [fdad3b4c317ee, fd52e841c473a] against the 0.02 m/s limit [fb71d8e3e3cdb]. Computation also worsened: candidate-minus-baseline mean_complete_update_s +2.4415 s [fb5514a65ad91], with deadline misses unchanged at 35 [fce1e8aa8726f, f9a041221be81].

So no retained signal supports a physical benefit from the change, and one clear regression (lost reach) plus holding and computation worsening argue against it. This disposition only accepts the report recommendation; it replaces no baseline and launches no work. Attribution remains under-constrained: one valid pair with differing recorded initialization selection (32 vs 29), no closed-loop counterfactual replay, full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces not retained (not_retained, not absence), and one-step projected comparisons (35 matched endpoints, candidate mean tip difference 0.0042 m [fd6c01bf0abaf, fe09dc3ffea9d]) are bounded probes that cannot explain the whole holding failure. Workflow completes here; no further candidate, check, or parameter change is selected.
